hypothesis: The current model can learn context-sensitive bindings and corrections when small contrastive families prevent fixed-answer shortcuts. Failure to overfit this control would motivate a training/capacity diagnosis before more broad data.
intervention: Small contrastive conversation data; unchanged own architecture, tokenizer, native last-reply loss and generation

successCriterionProposedBeforeTraining.selection: One complete family per competency and fold; both contrast branches. Select the latest turn with distinct expected responses within each pair (--prefix-turn contrast), yielding 12 TRAIN and 12 VALIDATION turns; known_vs_unknown selects turn 0.
successCriterionProposedBeforeTraining.control: At least 10 of 12 selected TRAIN turns fully correct with EOS; report both-branch discrimination. This measures learning/memorization only.
successCriterionProposedBeforeTraining.development: At least 8 of 12 selected VALIDATION turns fully correct with EOS, improvement over the identical frozen parent, and two generated-history dialogues correct after the authored initial context. Report both-branch discrimination, zero technical failures, inference errors or dropped history turns.
successCriterionProposedBeforeTraining.acceptance: No model promotion from this diagnostic. Preserve the separate new final criterion of 36/40, 8/10 and zero critical/technical failures.
